title: Bike over a cliff
phrase: 10 seconds of a cool action scene: a guy rides a bike over a cliff, ditches the bike mid-air and does a superhero landing

tiers.label: 1. The first prompt
tiers.what_you_get: A man in a dark red shirt and dark trousers, not the grey hoodie of the idea. He hangs in the air for about 4 seconds, the camera looks up at him, and he lands on a fist and stares into the lens.

tiers.label: 2. A clear prompt, no film language
tiers.what_you_get: The grey hoodie and jeans, a fast ride off the edge, and a landing on a knee and a fist. Dust fills the frame and the light is warm and even. He ends upright and looks off to the side.

tiers.label: 3. With shot-speak
tiers.what_you_get: 5 shots in the warm colour of red rock, with 1 hard sun. The close-up is on his hands as the bike leaves them. The landing is a low shot on the canyon floor with a big burst of dust. Then a medium shot shows his face as he stands, with the bike on the ground behind him.
